periods.time: vol-16 ch-004 flashback, night before the representative war

name.zh: 多多良警告一辉艾莉丝可能背叛
name.en: Tatara warns Ikki that Alice may betray them

periods.summary: Yui Tatara waits outside Ikki's room, teases him about Stella, and suddenly attacks with her chainsaw spiritual device to test whether he can fight immediately. She then asks him to help assassinate Alice before the war. As a professional killer, Yui argues that Alice's desire to kill Or-Gaule does not feel like genuine hatred; it is built from guilt, duty and other people's expectations. Since Alice and Or-Gaule are blood siblings, Yui predicts that when the final blow comes, the false cover over Alice's real feelings may break. Ikki refuses to murder an ally preemptively because he saw Alice's courage and wants to trust it, but he accepts responsibility and promises that if Yui's fear comes true he will personally stop Alice.
periods.cause: Yui identifies Alice as a strategic instability and wants to prevent a battlefield shift from five-against-four to six-against-four.
periods.outcome: Ikki rejects assassination but is mentally prepared to take responsibility when Alice later protects Or-Gaule.
periods.significance: Foreshadows Alice's betrayal and frames Ikki's later duel as the consequence of his deliberate choice to trust her rather than preemptively kill her.
